entities.summary: Tapio Wilska (b. 1969-09-19, Savonlinna) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Savonlinna and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
